introduction.p1: Welcome to my portfolio! Passionate about computer science and programming, I share here my key projects, developed at university or during my free time.
introduction.p2: From creating scripts to software, including server and data management, my ambition is to transform this passion into expertise, specializing as a Software Engineer / Full Stack Developer.

projects.title: Website for Dj URYA
projects.name: Dj URYA
projects.desc: This project consists of developing and updating the showcase and commercial website dj-urya.fr to allow clients to directly book musical performances online. It integrates a synchronized availability calendar with automated email confirmation via Resend, as well as a secure admin space and a custom CMS for dynamic content and database management.
features: Secure admin area and custom CMS

projects.title: Multiplayer Strategic Board Game
projects.name: Conquete
projects.desc: Creation of a strategic board game in Java, featuring an AI for local multiplayer games, save management, and the generation of statistical match charts.

projects.title: Air Traffic Simulator
projects.name: Aerien
projects.desc: This software engineering project is a real-time air traffic simulator designed to automatically model and manage aircraft movements and airport operations. It simulates complex scenarios including multiple flights, real-time flight paths, collision risk management, and unexpected events such as aviation emergencies.
features: Flight path and airport operations modeling
Aviation emergency and unexpected event handling

projects.title: Student Attendance Tracking System
projects.name: Presence
projects.desc: This project aims to design an automated attendance verification and management system using NFC smart cards for students or employees. It connects a Python hardware client reading badges via an ACR122U reader, a secure Spring Boot backend server validating schedules and preventing duplicates, and an admin web interface to manage history and attendance data.
features: Automated attendance tracking via NFC smart cards
Python hardware client for badge scanning
Secure Spring Boot backend preventing duplicate entries
Web admin interface for history and logs management

projects.title: Educational Application for Students
projects.name: learnpy
projects.desc: Development of an interactive Python application to teach programming to students. The application includes a custom code editor, real-time feedback generation, and student statistics storage.

projects.title: Online Tournament Generator
projects.name: Tournois
projects.desc: This project consists of developing a full-stack instant tournament management application capable of modeling competitions. It combines a React frontend in JavaScript for real-time score display and bracket generation with a secure REST API under Node.js/Express that handles user authentication, the favorites system, and data modification permissions.
features: Automatic and dynamic tournament bracket generation
Secure REST API with authentication and role-based permissions
